records.brief: A clear workforce-planning emblem, not a team inside a house: one deep-green upright personnel ID panel bearing a simple ivory human bust, three short aligned jade headcount bars, and a small terracotta two-ring hiring target integrated into the lower-right edge. The person, measured workforce bars and target form ONE compact balanced mark. Broad strong geometry. Forest #1F4945, pale jade #C0E7DD, warm peach #F1CAB1 and restrained terracotta. No house, roof, briefcase, arrows tree, text, numbers, flag or official seal.

records.concept: Emotional support and room to breathe
records.brief: A warm mental-wellbeing and emotional-support emblem: two soft eucalyptus-teal cupped hand/arm forms make a clean OPEN HEART silhouette around a small pale-sage human figure, represented by a round head and gentle shoulder curve. Generous air between the protective arms and the person gives breathing room. The silhouette must clearly read as a person held in a caring heart, not a decorative face, lungs, leaf or infinity loop. Teal #4A7480, sage #AEC7BB, off-white #F0F4F1. Tactile understated ceramic, very few rounded forms; no medical cross, ECG or clinical imagery.

records.brief: A strong property-dispute and fairness emblem: a simple dark-plum HOUSE OUTLINE with a peaked roof, containing one clearly recognizable balanced justice scale. The scale has a single warm-rose vertical stem, short horizontal beam and two equal ivory pans. House and balance share a coherent foundation and read as one compact symbol. Dark plum #3C283B, pale lavender #E3D7E9 and muted rose metal #BE8E9C. No gavel, key, court seal, document stack, tiny inscriptions or official crest. Clear silhouette at48px.

records.brief: A clear material-sorting and recycling emblem: two distinct material silhouettes, a folded warm-ivory paper sheet and a compact deep-petrol bottle, held side by side with a visible separation gap inside a bold orange ring made of THREE broad turning arrows. The arrows must visibly have arrowheads, not a generic twisted ribbon; they guide separated materials into a next use. Orange #DB5A27, ivory #F7F2E3 and petrol #1F3942. Few broad shapes, restrained dimensional depth. No text, certification badges, green leaf, generic trash bag or extra debris.
